Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match its polished soft fantasy children's illustration, fine warm brown outlines, delicate painterly shading, glossy expressive eyes, baby proportions and clean alpha edges. No whole-character jumping, no zoom, no exaggerated pose shifts. Preserve identity, markings and anatomy in all 16 cells. Entire image square, high resolution, clean transparent silhouette. Character description: Baby red panda, warm apricot red fur, cream eyebrow markings and cheeks, short chocolate paws, enormous striped tail curled alongside body, small maple-shaped fur marking below one ear.
